why: The common mistake, and it costs twice: everything before the first `: ` is the verb, so `vendor(yidam)` is in no list AND classification falls through to Epistemic, filing an operational commit as a change in understanding. Reported as its own rule rather than folded into `unrecognized-verb`, because it has a known cause and a known fix. A server that answered only `recognized: false` would send the caller looking for a verb that is already correct.
